text:
Maya: morning folks — quick handoff for the 03->11 UTC shift. Nothing critical, but a few items to watch.
Alex: thanks! quick TL;DR?
Maya: 1) Canary rollout of runtime-3.6 to eu-west-1 started at 02:10 UTC — CPU a bit higher on model-shard-2, monitoring. 2) Cache-TTL change merged yesterday: default prefix cache TTL lowered from 12h -> 6h, expect slightly more cold starts for rare prompts. 3) eu-volume-3 is at ~86% disk, eng-infra scheduled a prune job at 04:00 UTC.
Ravi: pinged infra on the disk cleanup. If it doesn't finish by 05:00 please escalate.
Alex: where's the canary runbook? link?
Maya: runbook: https://redwood.dev/runbooks/canary-deploys (see section 'runtime 3.6') — rollback trigger: model-shard-2 queue > 100 for 5m.
oncall-bot: Deployment: runtime-3.6-canary -> eu-west-1 — status: in-progress.
Jules: small uptick in 95th latency for chat endpoints on the canary after TTL change. 95p moved ~140ms -> ~210ms on a few nodes.
Maya: expected for cold-starts on uncommon prefixes. Watch metric 'prefix_cold_start_rate'. If >5% sustained over 10m, open incident.
Alex: CR ping — left comments on PR #4123 (batching threshold tweak). Need approval before end of shift.
Ravi: I can take CR if Alex is caught up.
Maya: action items: (1) Alex or someone merge PR #4123 or mark blocked; (2) Ravi monitor eu-volume-3 cleanup and escalate to eng-infra if disk >80% after 05:00 UTC; (3) Jules watch 95p on canary and be ready to flip rollback flag; (4) I'll follow up with SRE about model-shard balancing.
Alex: quick commands if you need to check disk/pods: ```kubectl -n redwood get pvc eu-volume-3 && kubectl -n redwood exec -it deploy/log-pruner -- du -sh /var/log/old | head```
Jules: taking watch on latency. I'll post anything notable and a 05:00 status.
Maya: going offline briefly — leaving shift to Ravi. Ping me if rollback needed. :wave:
Ravi: taking over. I'll post an update at 05:00 UTC or earlier.
oncall-bot: Reminder: @Ravi is scheduled as on-call until 11:00 UTC.
Maya: ttyl
